preview: This episode looks at personalized news feeds and how they shape a reader’s daily news. They may make it easier to find useful stories, while also raising questions about what a reader does not see and who sets those limits. By the end, you will have a clearer way to think about how a feed helps people stay informed and what may be missing.
comment_1: As you listen, notice the two ideas being compared and how they are connected.
comment_2: That question can feel different in everyday life. Now, listen to two readers speak for themselves, one after the other.
comment_3: You have heard two people describe a news feed in very different ways. Instead of deciding which voice is right, let us look at why the same situation can feel helpful to one person and limiting to another.
comment_4: So the question is not only who is right. We can also ask what is shaping this situation for each person.
